changelog:
- Initial release of the Auto-Updater skill.
- Automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily via cron.
- Sends you a summary message detailing updated components and any encountered issues.
- Provides setup instructions for enabling daily auto-updates, including manual cron configuration options.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and commands for manual update checks.
